sample_unit: cases (297 rare disease cases plus 1,719 challenging cases)
unlisted_practices: Structured multi-agent debate framework for LLM diagnostic reasoning
Ablation testing of multi-agent structure, base model choice, and token budget on diagnostic accuracy and safety rate

screen.reason: Evaluates a novel multi-agent debate architecture (DMoA) on benchmark clinical cases. While it reports accuracy and safety rates, developing and benchmarking a new multi-agent framework is considered model/system design rather than testing an organizational deployment safeguard or practice.
